dct_description_sm: This multiyear project was developed in order to create climate change adaptation plans for the Hesquiaht, Ahousaht, and Tla-o-qui-aht communities on Vancouver Island.  The main objectives of the project were: 1)To raise awareness of climate change and its impacts in Clayoquot communities and to develop adaptation measures for long-term sustainability; 2)To estimate changes in climate in the Clayoquot area from present to 2050;  3)To determine impacts (environmental, socio-economic and cultural), as well as vulnerabilities for communities in Clayoquot; 4)To construct a Resilience Planning Framework to determine adaptation measures to increase resilience of the communities; 5)To develop a realistic and practical Action Plan for adaptation that can be implemented in the next 20 years;  6)To train members of the Clayoquot community to measure and monitor key impacts over the next 20 years;  7)To implement the adaptation action plan in Clayoquot communities; and  8)To develop partnerships with other communities and organizations in the region.
